object:glob of black pudding.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a nearly black low glob with slate-gray glints and a broad dark base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of black pudding.wikiDescription: The black-pudding glob is a fleshy edible drop from black pudding.
object:glob of black pudding.modelBrief: Build an irregular low black pudding mass with subtle cool gray reflective patches. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:kelp frond.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark olive-brown branching kelp stem with several flat curling ochre blades and pale tan highlights. The broad blue-violet field with cyan flecks is water behind the kelp, not part of the plant.
object:kelp frond.wikiDescription: A kelp frond is a vegan plant food in NetHack. The wiki identity supports seaweed, while this tile supplies its exaggerated violet color.
object:kelp frond.modelBrief: Build one branching underwater frond: a narrow dark olive stipe with several curling flat brown-ochre ribbons and a few pale highlights. Keep the blue-violet water field out of the mesh; compare the kelp silhouette against both neutral and original backgrounds.

object:eucalyptus leaf.visualDescription: PixelHack shows one pointed dark green leaf with a yellow-brown center and short stem. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:eucalyptus leaf.wikiDescription: An eucalyptus leaf is a plant-based edible item. Its exact leaf pattern is set by PixelHack.
object:eucalyptus leaf.modelBrief: Build a narrow pointed green leaf with clear central vein, slightly curled tip, and short stem. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:apple.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a round red apple with pale peach highlight, dark upper notch, and short brown stem. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:apple.wikiDescription: An apple is an edible fruit in NetHack. The familiar apple form matches the sprite.
object:apple.modelBrief: Build a compact red apple with notched top, stubby brown stem, and one pale highlight. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:orange.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a round orange fruit with mottled warm-yellow center and dark bottom shadow. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:orange.wikiDescription: An orange is a fruit comestible in NetHack. The sprite shows one whole fruit.
object:orange.modelBrief: Build a single near-spherical orange with orange peel, small mottled yellow highlight, and dark base. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:pear.visualDescription: PixelHack shows an upright golden pear tapering to a narrow neck, with a dark brown stem. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:pear.wikiDescription: A pear is a fruit comestible in NetHack. The wiki does not specify a variety or color.
object:pear.modelBrief: Build a plump gold pear with narrow neck, brown stem, and pale front glint. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:melon.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a large mottled olive-brown melon with small green patches and a short stem. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:melon.wikiDescription: A melon is an edible fruit in NetHack. The rough mottled surface is specific to this tile.
object:melon.modelBrief: Build a bulky round melon with irregular olive rind, subtle green mottling, and short stem. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:banana.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a curved golden banana with dark brown ends and pale inner edge. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:banana.wikiDescription: A banana is a fruit comestible in NetHack. The tile depicts a whole unpeeled banana.
object:banana.modelBrief: Build one curved golden banana with tapered dark ends and broad pale inner highlight. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:carrot.visualDescription: PixelHack shows an orange tapered carrot slanting down right beneath two short green leaves. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:carrot.wikiDescription: A carrot is a plant food in NetHack. The tapered orange root and leafy crown are visible tile details.
object:carrot.modelBrief: Build a single tapered orange carrot root with a small dark green leafy top. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:sprig of wolfsbane.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a cluster of dark green leaves and stems topped by several violet-blue flowers. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:sprig of wolfsbane.wikiDescription: A sprig of wolfsbane is a plant comestible in NetHack. The wiki name supports a flowering sprig, not a fixed flower hue.
object:sprig of wolfsbane.modelBrief: Build a small upright herb sprig with branching dark green leaves and a few blue-violet blooms. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:clove of garlic.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a small off-white garlic clove with purple upper skin and brown lower shading. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:clove of garlic.wikiDescription: A clove of garlic is a plant comestible in NetHack. The sprite shows one clove rather than a full bulb.
object:clove of garlic.modelBrief: Build a single curved ivory garlic clove with purple-tinted skin near its pointed end. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:slime mold.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a golden-brown cluster of many knobby lobes on a dark branched base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:slime mold.wikiDescription: Slime mold is NetHack's default name for a customizable fruit. The tile supplies a knobby cluster even though the in-game name can change.
object:slime mold.modelBrief: Build an irregular golden-brown lobed cluster on a short dark base; preserve the tile rather than treating the configurable name as anatomy. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.
